title: Phase module manifest
description: The manifest of one lifecycle phase as a module (EE-126), at packages/naive/src/phases/<id>/phase.json: the phase's question, its stage gate (what the gate asks, after Cooper's stage-gate) and the exit evidence the gate requires, the function workflows active in the phase and the weights that rank decisions across the 13 functions. A phase module has no agent and owns no records. It is the one place a phase's name, question and gate are defined: packages/naive/src/engine/lifecycle.ts, the route table and Product Anatomy read them from here. Its need-now priors are not held here: packages/naive/src/phases/phases.ts derives them from packages/naive/src/engine/need-now.json and packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json. packages/naive/src/checks/check-phases.ts checks every module.

id.description: The phase (EE-012), the same as the folder's name.

step.description: The phase's place in the lifecycle, from 1 (discovery) to 5 (platform).

binding_constraint.description: What limits the venture most in this phase. Discovery has none, because no product is ranked before the core product exists.

gate.description: The stage gate at the end of the phase: its name, the questions a person answers at the gate, and the exit evidence the gate requires whatever lifecycle playbook the venture follows. A playbook may rename the gate and add the evidence its own ordering needs.

name.description: The gate's name, such as Problem-solution fit.

asks.description: The questions the gate asks, each answered from the evidence.

source.description: The venture record type (an id in data-model.json) the evidence is kept in.

workflows.description: The function workflows active in the phase, as <function>/<workflow> (packages/naive/src/functions/<function>/workflows/<workflow>.json).

weights.description: How much each function's open decisions count when decisions are ranked across functions in this phase. One entry per departments.json id, summing to 1.

version.description: 0.x while the weights are unvalidated priors.
